title: Helpful app
body: I really like the ease of use and easy to understand visuals with this app. It definitely helps me with seeing how I’m doing at achieving (or not achieving) my goals. title: Great habit tracking app!
body:
I have now been using this app for a year and am so committed to it, I’m getting a lifetime membership.

It’s so easy to customize for yourself and the paid versions allow you to put notes in for extra tracking which is great for exercise details as well.

Totally motivating - I’m so happy to find something that works well for me.

Oh and if you have any trouble, Kevin, the app’s creator, is very responsive and helpful to ensure you’re all sorted out - thanks again, Kevin for being a rockstar and making a positive difference in my life on a daily basis!

author: livi_2727

title: Powerful Companion
body: This app is a powerful motivator and companion on my journey of giving up alcohol. It counts up every day since my last relapse (Day 98 now!). Every day gives me new joy as I see the “days since” grow one number higher. The “days since” number is displayed attractively on a widget on my phone and makes me smile every time I see it. It has stopped me from relapsing when I look at the widget and know I would lose all those lovely days of victory if I were to give in. Thanks so much for this wonderful app; it’s not only attractive and fun, but it has made an amazing difference in my life to help me free myself from a destructive dependency. What can compare to that? Thanks and 5 stars isn’t enough; I give it 10 out of 5.
